messages.text: Give me exactly two options for a general recruiter follow-up: option one is a short phone call, option two is a short email draft. Name each option clearly. Do not send anything or use contacts.

Option 1 — Short Phone Call Script

"Hi [Recruiter's name], this is [Your name]. I'm following up on my application for the [Job title] role. I wanted to confirm my materials were received and reiterate my interest. Would it be possible to hear about the timeline for next steps? Thank you — I look forward to hearing from you."

Option 2 — Short Email Draft

Subject: Following up — [Job title] application

Hi [Recruiter's name],

I hope you're doing well. I'm following up on my application for the [Job title] role, submitted on [date]. I remain very interested in the position and would appreciate any update on the timeline or next steps.

Thank you for your time,
[Your name]
[Your phone number]

Nothing has been sent and no contacts were used.
